note: Tunes mix step 4: three tunes by ear, Hard, Easy and Medium in that order with no word on which is which; for each the singer hears Do (the last note) and the first note before singing, sings the second from the staff before hearing it, and learns the third in the named stages. Key and tempo are moves (60 up to 90) in place of the old Key selector, with a {{?key}} line.

exercise.title: Three tunes, easy to hard, in no order
exercise.why: Every tune in the book ends on Do, so its last note tells you where home is and how far from home the tune starts, and those two things tell you what to listen for before you sing.

cells.text:
The three tunes here are of different difficulty, and nothing says which is which. Tap the last note of the tune below to hear Do, then tap its first note.
Then press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}}: the mic starts with it. Listen once, then sing along on "la".
If the tune goes where you did not expect, listen once more for its lowest note, then sing along again.

cells.heading: Sing it before you hear it

cells.text:
Tap the last note of this tune below to hear Do, then tap its first note. Sing the tune slowly from the staff before you hear it. Sing it on "la".
Then press Play below to check it against the tune: the mic starts with it, so sing along this time.
If your tune and the one you hear part ways, tap the note where they did, then sing on from there.

Tap the last note of this tune below to hear Do, then tap its first note. Then press Play below to hear the tune: the mic starts with it. Listen for its widest move, then sing along on "la".
Sing along with the tune a few times. Then press Tune below to mute the tune, and sing it over the chords alone.
Once you can start the tune without tapping its first note, press Chords to mute the chords too, and sing the tune a cappella.
{{?key}}In another key Do moves, and each tune still starts the same distance from it.
